verdict.rationale: Forter documents a separate sandbox/TEST environment, alongside production, for verifying an integration before production deployment. That covers the core of testing against a sandbox. The docs only imply that production data is never touched, and nothing shows how the sandbox works for AI-native workflows such as the MCP server. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of data isolation between sandbox and production, details on sandbox credentials and test data or simulated decisions, whether the MCP or agent tooling can target the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Forter has both a production and a sandbox environment for your development process.
The main objective of the TEST site is to allow you to verify the integration prior to its deployment in the production environment.
